installation.title: Installation
installation.description: Install the Qamposer React library from npm:

quickStart.title: Quick Start (QamposerMicro)
quickStart.description: The simplest way to get started. QamposerMicro is a lightweight component perfect for tutorials and embedded widgets. Pass localAdapter() and ideal simulation runs right in the browser — no server to set up.

fullVersion.title: Full Version (Qamposer)
fullVersion.description: For the full IDE experience with visualization (Q-sphere, histograms), install Plotly as well:
fullVersion.usage: Then use the full Qamposer component. The visualization panels are driven by simulation results, so localAdapter is enough to see them fill in as you edit:

localSimulation.title: Real-Time Local Simulation (localAdapter)
localSimulation.description: Since v0.2.0, localAdapter runs ideal (noiseless) state-vector simulation entirely in the browser. Every circuit edit is simulated instantly, and it returns counts, seeded sampling, and Q-sphere data in the same format as the backend — with zero extra dependencies.
localSimulation.options: Its defaults work as-is, and each one can be overridden:
notes: Auto-simulation runs on every circuit change with 1024 shots, so results update as you edit.
Ideal (noiseless) profiles only — noisy fake devices and real hardware still need a backend adapter.
Circuits wider than maxQubits (default: 12) are rejected.
Q-sphere points are emitted for circuits of 5 qubits or fewer.

backend.title: Backend Setup (Optional)
backend.description: A backend is only needed for noisy fake devices and real hardware, which run through "Set up and run". Ideal simulation no longer requires a server.
backend.combined: The two adapters work together: the backend handles noisy fake devices via "Set up and run", while localAdapter gives instant ideal feedback on every edit.

adapters.title: Choosing an Adapter
adapters.description: Three adapters ship with the library, and they can be mixed through the adapter and realtimeAdapter props:

local.bestFor: Instant ideal simulation with no server

qiskit.bestFor: Noisy fake devices via "Set up and run"

editorOnly.title: Editor-Only Mode
editorOnly.description: If you only need the circuit editor without simulation, use the noopAdapter. It is also the default when no adapter is given:
